_comment: Migration map from the old freeform ingest-invented categories to the closed taxonomy. Applied to data/tools.json; each migrated entry keeps its old value in `category_original`. `overrides` is keyed by entry id and wins over `map` (used where one old category string covered entries that genuinely belong in different new categories).

taxonomy.ai-coding: Building and shipping software with AI: coding agents, Claude Code workflows/plugins/commands, AI code review and code security, coding prompts and token/context tuning.
taxonomy.ai-agents-and-automation: Autonomous and multi-agent systems, agent frameworks, agent swarms, and agentic workflow/business automation.
taxonomy.ai-prompting: Prompting technique itself: prompt templates, council/loop patterns, prompt libraries, research prompts.
taxonomy.ai-models-and-apis: The models and the pipes: frontier and open-weight models, local LLM runtimes, model API access platforms.
taxonomy.ai-productivity: Using AI for thinking and daily work: second brain, knowledge management, research and search, learning, dashboards, general AI productivity suites and tips.
taxonomy.design-and-ui: Visual and interface design: design systems, UI component libraries, animation, design tooling and design prompting.
taxonomy.video-and-film: Video and moving image: AI video generation and editing, video understanding, production automation, filmmaking and cinematic reference.
taxonomy.music-and-audio: Music production, mixing and vocal chains, instruments and gear, voice and audio tooling.
taxonomy.images-and-3d: Still images and 3D: image generation, image processing, computer vision, 3D modelling and photogrammetry.
taxonomy.dev-tools-and-infrastructure: General (not AI-specific) engineering tooling: browser automation, networking, auth, file/document conversion, metadata, infrastructure engineering.
taxonomy.marketing-and-content: Reaching an audience: SEO and AI search visibility, social media analytics, content clipping and repurposing, content structure craft.
taxonomy.business-and-career: Business, career and industry: entrepreneurship, client management, career paths and certifications, AI industry analysis and news.
taxonomy.personal-finance: Money: tax planning, investing, trading and financial forecasting, economic commentary.
taxonomy.science-and-space: Physics, astronomy, cosmology and science/philosophy explainers.
taxonomy.climate-and-environment: Climate science, paleoclimate, sustainability, and climate/earth data visualisation.
taxonomy.health-and-psychology: Mental health, neurodivergence, psychology, mental models and personal change.
taxonomy.home-and-diy: Hands-on making and the home: gardening, woodworking, crafts, practical skills.
taxonomy.privacy-and-security: Personal data privacy, data broker removal, and AI/consumer security risk awareness.
taxonomy.other: Genuinely unclassifiable — no usable metadata. Keep as close to empty as possible.

airllm.why: Old category was the generic 'other'; AirLLM is a runtime for large models on consumer hardware, not a dev tool.

openclaw.why: Old category was 'claude-workflow' (which otherwise means Claude Code tooling); OpenClaw is an always-on autonomous agent.
